name: Hoshimiya Kanon
source:
The selfish young lady who is daughter of the chief director of the general hospital, looks down on other people. Because she grew up constantly being pampered from surroundings, she behaves like a tyrant with an arrogant attitude. Due to high pride, she never ask for help. She go to school by a train to know the life of commoner by her father's order. She doesn't like crowded places, and terribly disgusted by crowded train where her body touches others'. In addition, she has considerable dissatisfaction with her body that growth is immature.
